analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has entered oversold territory, and ADX shows no trend formation. The current price of 213,000 KRW is trading sideways between the swing support at 204,500 KRW and the swing resistance at 223,000 KRW.
